title: Google sign-in
startFailed: Unable to open Google sign-in. Please try again.
notLinked: This Google account can't sign in here yet. Its address must match your login's verified email: sign in once with an email link, then try Google again.
noAccount: No login at this gym uses that Google address. Ask your gym to invite you, or sign in another way.
failed: That sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
on: Staff and members can sign in with a Google account. It signs in an existing login only: the Google address must match the login's email, and both must be verified. Nobody gets a new login through Google.
source: This install's operator set up the Google OAuth client in the server's configuration. To turn Google sign-in off, remove it there.
redirect: Authorized redirect URI for this gym
redirectHelp: The OAuth client in Google Cloud must list this address exactly.
